title: Adult Spinal Deformity Surgery Real-World Functional Activity
official: Real-World Functional Activity in Adult Spinal Deformity Surgery
summary: The purpose of this study is to measure functional activity and stability in spinal deformity patients utilizing motion analysis testing and accelerometers.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of degenerative thoracolumbar deformity
* Deformity correction surgery scheduled with either Dr. Elder or Dr. Fogelson, minimum 4-level fusion with fixation to the pelvis.

Exclusion Criteria:

° Unable to return to Mayo Clinic for follow-up evaluation
